I can’t modify messages or add reactions to msg_12345 from here. I don’t have access to your messaging platform.

If you’d like, I can help with:
- Weather: Tell me a location and I’ll fetch the forecast.
- Time: I can provide the current UTC time.

Or you can paste the thumbs up emoji yourself: 👍

If you tell me which app you’re using, I can give you step-by-step instructions to add a reaction there.
